title: 第15章 一个不留第16章 杀向妖王洞府
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
刹那间。
十五头妖兽，有魔纹黑熊，白毛鼠狮，长臂暴猿等，抛下手中的食物，眼露凶光，嚎叫着冲向李易和李凡两兄弟。
这些妖兽全是高达三四米的异兽，外形丑陋，煞气浓烈，气势汹汹，一起冲来，当真有千军万马之势。
别说普通人看着脚软，连一般的修士也会吓得掉头就逃。
不过李易和李凡并没有逃走，反而战意高昂，主动迎了上去。
牢笼里。
一群被关押的人看着这一幕，眼神麻木又绝望，这些妖兽有多强大，他们最为清楚，这三十年来，不是没有侠士路过临荒城，想要为民除害，最终的结局都是落入妖兽之腹，无一例外！
大战就此展开。
李易手持玄器长剑，身如鬼魅，闯入妖兽中，手起剑落，直接将一头二阶巅峰的白毛鼠狮削掉了脑袋，随后以一个横扫，两头二阶初期的妖兽又被腰斩。
整个过程行云流水，轻松惬意。
一旁李凡就血腥暴力很多，他修行是肉身，无法催动武器增幅力量，但他的手脚膝盖，乃至全身上下都是武器。
直接一拳将一头二阶中期的长臂暴猿的脑袋打爆了，接着又一个扫腿，将一只魔纹黑熊踢得肚漏肠出，惨叫不已，场面血腥可怕到了极点，
他仿佛就是一头人形凶兽，而这些妖兽都是可怜的小兽。
“这……”
广场中的衙役和士兵看呆了，眼里满是震惊，这两个少年的实力也太恐怖了吧，杀妖兽如探囊取物啊。
牢笼中，原本绝望的人群眼珠里泛起了一丝希望，脸上透着一抹畅快，即使最终自己会死，看着妖兽被杀，也是极为痛快开心的事情。
“你们还站着做什么，过来帮忙啊，否则他俩杀光我们，你们也活不成。”
独角魔狼越战越心惊，浑身发寒，感到死亡的危机，扭头朝一群惊讶呆滞的衙役和士兵大喊。
“杀。”
在场的衙役和士兵如梦初醒，大部分手持灵器大刀冲了过来，加入战场，少部分不知道是害怕，还是其他原因，站在原地，没有参战，但也没有逃走。

“来得好，正好一起解决。”
李易眼神凌厉，手中的玄器长剑划过一道道流光，每一剑落下，都有一个人或者一头妖兽横死剑下。
短短几十瞬，他便杀了九头妖兽，三十多名衙役和士兵，全身都被鲜血染红了，犹如一个浴血修罗。
“快逃啊，这两人是恶魔。”
终于，一群养尊处优的衙役和士兵崩溃了，四散逃走，他们怕了。
“我说过，你们今日都会死。”
李易目光冰冷，以鬼魅般的速度进行追杀，转眼间便有十多个衙役和士兵死于剑下，一个都没有放过。
李凡同样如此，出手全是杀招，对这群吃人的妖兽，和率兽食人的人渣毫不留情。
不多时。
整个广场便只剩下了一具具尸体，有妖兽，也有官兵。
钱捕头和妖兽头领独角魔狼逃出广场，正在疯狂朝连云山方向奔跑。
“哥，那头狼妖交给我，那人类畜生交给你如何？”
李凡舔了舔手上沾染的兽血，眼里杀机弥漫，快速追了上去。
content_en:
In an instant.
Fifteen monster beasts, including a black bear with magic patterns, a white-haired rat-lion, a long-armed ape, etc., dropped the food in their hands, showed fierce eyes, howled and rushed towards the two brothers Li Yi and Li Fan.
These monsters are all three or four meters tall, with ugly appearance, strong evil aura, and menacing momentum. They charge together, and they are like thousands of troops.
Not to mention ordinary people looking weak, even ordinary monks would be so frightened that they would turn around and run away.
However, Li Yi and Li Fan did not escape. Instead, they took the initiative to greet them with high fighting spirit.
In the cage.
A group of imprisoned people looked at this scene with numb and desperate eyes. They knew best how powerful these monsters were. In the past thirty years, there were no knights who passed by Linhuang City and wanted to eliminate harm for the people. In the end, they all ended up falling into the belly of the monsters, without exception!
The war began.
Li Yi was holding a mysterious long sword, and like a ghost, he broke into the monsters. He raised the sword and cut off the head of a white-haired rat lion at the peak of the second level. Then with a sweep, two early second-level monsters were cut in half.
The whole process was smooth and smooth, relaxed and comfortable.
Li Fan on the other side was very bloody and violent. He practiced in the flesh and could not activate weapons to increase their power, but his hands, feet, knees, and even his whole body were weapons.
He punched a mid-level second-level gibbon's head to pieces, and then swept his legs, kicking a magic-marked black bear until its intestines leaked out. It screamed in agony. The scene was extremely bloody and terrifying.
He seemed to be a ferocious beast in human form, and these monsters were all pitiful little beasts.
"This..."
The government officials and soldiers in the square were stunned, their eyes full of shock. The strength of these two young men must be too terrifying. Killing monsters is like picking out objects from a bag.
In the cage, there was a glimmer of hope in the eyes of the originally desperate crowd, and a touch of joy appeared on their faces. Even if they would die in the end, watching the monsters being killed was an extremely joyful thing.
"Why are you still standing? Come and help, otherwise they will kill us all and you won't survive."
The more the one-horned demon wolf fought, the more frightened he became. He was shivering all over and felt the danger of death. He turned around and shouted at a group of stunned government officials and soldiers.
"Kill."
The government officials and soldiers present seemed to have woken up from a dream. Most of them rushed over with swords and swords, and joined the battlefield. A small number of them stood there, not knowing whether it was fear or other reasons. They did not join the battle, but they did not escape either.
"It's a good time to come, we can solve it together."
Li Yi's eyes were sharp, and the mysterious sword in his hand flashed streaks of light. Every time the sword fell, a person or a monster died under the sword.
In just a few dozen seconds, he killed nine monsters and more than thirty government officials and soldiers. His whole body was stained red with blood, like a blood-soaked Shura.
"Run away, these two are demons."
Finally, a group of pampered government officials and soldiers collapsed and fled in all directions. They were afraid.
"I said, you will all die today."
Li Yi's eyes were cold, and he pursued him at a ghostly speed. In the blink of an eye, more than a dozen government officials and soldiers died under the sword, and no one was spared.
The same is true for Li Fan, all his attacks are killing moves, and he shows no mercy to the group of man-eating monsters and the scum who lead the beasts to eat people.
Not long after.
There were only corpses left in the entire square, including monsters and beasts, as well as officers and soldiers.
Qian Captou and the monster leader, the One-Horned Demon Wolf, escaped from the square and were running madly towards Lianyun Mountain.
"Brother, how about leaving the wolf monster to me and the human beast to you?"
Li Fan licked the animal blood on his hands, his eyes filled with murderous intent, and he quickly chased after him.
